title: Validating Autoformalized Specifications via Contrapuntal Languages
title_zh: 通过对位语言验证自动形式化规约

paragraphs.en: Formal specifications can make AI-generated code mechanically checkable. Because user intent is typically expressed in natural language rather than formal logic, specifications must first be derived from it, e.g., via LLM-based autoformalization. Yet autoformalized specifications are themselves untrusted, so a key challenge is validating whether they capture user intent without relying on a costly oracle such as human review. In this oracle-free setting, a natural strategy is to vote among model outputs, but because model errors are often correlated, agreement among outputs may reflect shared mistakes rather than correctness. Our key insight is that these errors can be decorrelated through representational diversity. We achieve this diversity with contrapuntal languages : pairs of task-specific formal languages, each designed to express the intended specification, yet admitting no structure-preserving translation between them. An LLM formalizes the intent independently in each language, and we accept a specification only if a solver proves the two formalizations equivalent. Because the model must discover separately how to express the intent in each language’s constructs, agreement is less likely to reflect a correlated error than agreement within a single language. To construct such languages, we present a synthesis algorithm that reuses fragments of sampled seed specifications as syntactic sugar over a base specification language. We implement the approach for first-order logic specifications and evaluate it on HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench using GPT-5.4 mini and Qwen3.6-Flash with and without thinking. Over the strongest baseline among direct generation, plurality voting, and round-trip verification, our method increases the proportion of accepted specifications that are correct, i.e., complete and sound, by 12.0% on HumanEval+ and 42.9% on LiveCodeBench. The accepted specifications judged complete are more effective at detecting bugs: they reject 98.6% of buggy program variants on HumanEval+ and 96.2% on LiveCodeBench, compared with 92.8% and 78.3% for the strongest baseline. A case study shows how disagreement between contrapuntal languages can surface ambiguity in a natural-language task.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化规约可以使AI生成的代码具备机械可验证性。 由于用户意图通常以自然语言而非形式逻辑表达，因此必须先从用户意图中推导出规约，例如通过基于大语言模型的自动形式化。 然而自动形式化得到的规约本身也是不可信的，因此一个关键挑战是：在不依赖人工审查这类昂贵判定标准的情况下，验证规约是否准确捕捉了用户意图。 在这种无判定标准的场景下，一种自然策略是对多个模型输出进行投票，但由于模型的错误往往是相关的，输出之间的一致可能反映的是共同的错误而非正确性。 我们的核心洞察是：这些错误可以通过表示的多样性来去相关。 我们通过对位语言来实现这种多样性：对位语言是成对的面向特定任务的形式语言，每一种都被设计为能够表达目标规约，但两者之间不存在保持结构的翻译。 我们让大语言模型在每种语言中独立地对意图进行形式化，只有当求解器证明两个形式化结果等价时，才接受该规约。 由于模型必须分别探索如何在每种语言的构造中表达意图，因此输出之间的一致比单一语言内部的一致更不可能反映相关错误。 为了构建这样的语言，我们提出了一种综合算法，该算法将采样的种子规约片段复用为底层规约语言之上的语法糖。 我们针对一阶逻辑规约实现了该方法，并在HumanEval+和LiveCodeBench上使用GPT-5.4 mini和Qwen3.6-Flash（分别开启与关闭思考模式）进行了评估。 相较于直接生成、多数投票和往返验证中最强的基线方法，我们的方法在HumanEval+上将被接受规约中正确的比例（即既完备又可靠）提升了12.0%，在LiveCodeBench上提升了42.9%。 被判定为完备的已接受规约在检测缺陷方面更为有效：它们在HumanEval+上拒绝了98.6%的有缺陷程序变体，在LiveCodeBench上拒绝了96.2%，而最强基线方法分别仅为92.8%和78.3%。 案例研究展示了对位语言之间的分歧如何能够揭示自然语言任务中的歧义。

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) generate code faster than humans can review it ( Mozannar et al., 2024 ; Duma et al., 2026 ) , the central challenge is shifting from generating code to determining whether that code faithfully captures the user’s intent. A promising answer is intent autoformalization : automatically translating natural-language intent into formal specifications against which generated code can be mechanically verified. Yet this only relocates the trust problem: if the specification is itself produced by a fallible autoformalization process, does it capture the user’s intent expressed in natural language? Prior studies on HumanEval tasks show that generating behaviorally correct postconditions and contracts from natural-language intent remains challenging for LLMs ( Endres et al., 2024 ; Richter and Wehrheim, 2025 ; Prasetya et al., 2026 ) . For example, even for Python contracts on HumanEval, the setting most familiar to LLMs, only 39.5% of GPT-5-generated contracts that raised no false alarms on the reference implementation rejected every evaluated mutant ( Richter and Wehrheim, 2025 ) . However, validating generated specifications typically requires costly human review, making oracle-free validation a central bottleneck for reliable AI-assisted software development ( Lahiri, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）生成代码的速度超过人类的审查速度（Mozannar et al., 2024; Duma et al., 2026），核心挑战正从生成代码转向判断这些代码是否忠实地捕捉了用户意图。 一个有前景的答案是意图自动形式化：自动将自然语言意图翻译成形式化规约，使生成的代码能够据此进行机械化验证。 然而这只是转移了信任问题：如果规约本身是由易错的自动形式化过程产生的，那么它是否捕捉了用户用自然语言表达的意图？ 先前关于 HumanEval 任务的研究表明，从自然语言意图生成行为正确的后置条件与契约对 LLM 而言仍然具有挑战性（Endres et al., 2024; Richter and Wehrheim, 2025; Prasetya et al., 2026）。 例如，即使在 LLM 最熟悉的 HumanEval 上的 Python 契约场景中，GPT-5 生成的契约在参考实现上不产生误报的情况下，也只有 39.5% 能拒绝所有被评估的变异体（Richter and Wehrheim, 2025）。 然而，验证生成的规约通常需要代价高昂的人工审查，这使得无测试预言机验证成为可靠的 AI 辅助软件开发的核心瓶颈（Lahiri, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: How can we validate whether autoformalized specifications accurately capture the user’s intent without an external oracle? A straightforward approach is voting. Plurality voting ( Hansen and Salamon, 1990 ; Li et al., 2024 ) partitions the specifications into equivalence classes and selects the largest, i.e., the most frequently occurring semantics. However, LLM-generated artifacts often exhibit correlated errors ( Kim et al., 2025 ) ; when multiple candidates share the same mistake, plurality voting can reinforce the dominant error rather than identify the correct answer ( Tumer and Ghosh, 1996 ) . Also, plurality voting treats each candidate as an indivisible vote, ignoring its internal structure: a candidate need not be correct as a whole for some of its components to be useful. Clause2Inv ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , for example, shows that clauses extracted from invalid invariant candidates can contribute to a valid invariant. Yet reusing such fragments naively would steer the model back toward the same formalizations, and thus the same errors. The challenge is therefore to reuse useful fragments while inducing sufficiently different formalization paths.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有外部判定标准的情况下，我们如何验证自动形式化得到的规约是否准确捕捉了用户的意图？ 一种直接的方法是投票。 多数投票（Hansen and Salamon, 1990；Li et al., 2024）将规约划分为等价类，并选择最大的类，即出现频率最高的语义。 然而，大语言模型生成的产物往往存在相关错误（Kim et al., 2025）；当多个候选共享同一错误时，多数投票可能会强化这一占主导地位的错误，而不是识别出正确答案（Tumer and Ghosh, 1996）。 此外，多数投票将每个候选视为不可分割的一票，忽略了其内部结构：某个候选并不需要整体正确，其部分组件才可能有用。 例如，Clause2Inv（Cao et al., 2025）表明，从无效的不变式候选中提取的子句可以为构造有效的不变式作出贡献。 然而，天真地复用这类片段会使模型重新走向相同的形式化结果，从而陷入相同的错误。 因此，挑战在于如何复用有用的片段，同时引导出足够不同的形式化路径。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we build on the insight that representational diversity can break the correlation between errors. Inspired by linguistic determinism—the hypothesis that language shapes thought ( Whorf, 1956 ) —we introduce contrapuntal languages : pairs of task-specific formal languages, each designed to express the intended specification, yet admitting no structure-preserving translation between them. An LLM formalizes the intent independently in each language, and we accept a specification only if a solver proves the two formalizations equivalent. Because the model must discover separately how to express the intent in each language’s constructs, cross-language agreement is less likely to reflect a correlated error than agreement within a single language.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们基于这样一个洞见：表征的多样性可以打破错误之间的相关性。 受语言决定论——即语言塑造思维的假说（Whorf, 1956）——的启发，我们引入了对位语言：成对的任务专用形式语言，每一种都被设计用于表达预期的规约，但二者之间不存在保持结构的翻译。 一个大语言模型在每种语言中独立地将意图形式化，只有当求解器证明这两个形式化等价时，我们才接受该规约。 由于模型必须在每种语言的结构中分别探索如何表达意图，因此跨语言的一致比单一语言内部的一致更不可能反映相关联的错误。

paragraphs.en: To construct such languages, we present a synthesis algorithm that builds both languages as syntactic sugar over a base specification language. We first sample seed specifications for the task from the LLM; the algorithm then cuts each seed into fragments and turns them into language constructs, using a solver to choose cuts that carve every seed into differently shaped trees in the two languages. Since the intended specification is unknown, the seeds stand in for it: we call a language pair effectively contrapuntal for a seed set when every seed can be represented in both languages, but no AST-level structure-preserving translation relates its representations across them. This design also addresses the challenge of reusing fragments: seed fragments let the model reuse useful components, even from incorrect seeds, while the structural incompatibility of the two languages still forces separate formalization paths and thus decorrelates errors.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建这样的语言，我们提出了一种综合算法，将两种语言都构建为在一个基础规范语言之上的语法糖。 我们首先从大语言模型中为任务采样种子规范；然后该算法将每个种子切分为片段并将其转化为语言构件，同时使用求解器选择切分方式，使每个种子在两种语言中被切分成形状不同的树。 由于预期的规范是未知的，种子便代表它：我们称一个语言对相对于某个种子集是有效对位的，当每个种子都能在两种语言中被表示，但没有任何 AST 层面的保结构翻译能将其在两种语言中的表示关联起来。 这一设计还解决了片段复用的难题：种子片段让模型能够复用有用的组件，即使来自错误的种子，而两种语言在结构上的不兼容仍会迫使各自独立的规范化路径，从而使错误去相关。

sents.en: Since the intended specification is unknown, the seeds stand in for it: we call a language pair effectively contrapuntal for a seed set when every seed can be represented in both languages, but no AST-level structure-preserving translation relates its representations across them.

sents.en: This design also addresses the challenge of reusing fragments: seed fragments let the model reuse useful components, even from incorrect seeds, while the structural incompatibility of the two languages still forces separate formalization paths and thus decorrelates errors.
sents.zh: 这一设计还解决了片段复用的难题：种子片段让模型能够复用有用的组件，即使来自错误的种子，而两种语言在结构上的不兼容仍会迫使各自独立的规范化路径，从而使错误去相关。

paragraphs.en: We implement the approach for first-order logic specifications in SMT-LIB and evaluate it on HumanEval+ ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) using GPT-5.4 mini and Qwen3.6-Flash with and without thinking. We compare it against direct generation, plurality voting, and round-trip verification, judging a specification complete if it accepts reference input–output pairs and sound if it rejects the outputs of buggy program variants. Over the strongest baseline, our method increases the proportion of accepted specifications that are both complete and sound by 12.0% on HumanEval+ and 42.9% on LiveCodeBench, and the accepted specifications judged complete reject 98.6% and 96.2% of buggy program variants, respectively, compared with 92.8% and 78.3% for the strongest baseline. An ablation shows that these gains depend on enforcing contrapuntality rather than merely using two languages, and a case study shows that disagreement between contrapuntal languages can surface ambiguity in a task description.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SMT-LIB 中实现了针对一阶逻辑规约的该方法，并在 HumanEval+（Liu 等，2023）和 LiveCodeBench（Jain 等，2025）上使用 GPT-5.4 mini 和 Qwen3.6-Flash（开启与关闭思考模式）进行评估。 我们将其与直接生成、多数投票和往返验证进行比较，如果一个规约接受参考输入–输出对则判定其为完备的，如果其拒绝有缺陷程序变体的输出则判定其为可靠的。 相较于最强基线，我们的方法使既完备又可靠的被接受规约的比例在 HumanEval+ 上提高了 12.0%，在 LiveCodeBench 上提高了 42.9%，且被判定为完备的被接受规约分别拒绝 98.6% 和 96.2% 的有缺陷程序变体，而最强基线分别为 92.8% 和 78.3%。 消融实验表明，这些提升依赖于强制对位性，而不仅仅是使用两种语言；案例研究表明，对位语言之间的分歧能够揭示任务描述中的歧义。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: A new approach that automatically validates autoformalized specifications without an oracle through contrapuntal languages .
paragraphs.zh: 一种通过对位语言在无预言机的情况下自动验证自动形式化规约的新方法。

paragraphs.en: An algorithm to automatically synthesize contrapuntal languages with an SMT solver.
paragraphs.zh: 一种使用 SMT 求解器自动合成对位语言的算法。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation on HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench showing that contrapuntal languages accept a higher proportion of complete and sound specifications than three baselines, and that the accepted specifications judged complete detect more bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 一项在 HumanEval+ 和 LiveCodeBench 上的评估表明，对位语言接受完整且可靠规范的比例高于三个基线方法，且在被判定为完整的已接受规范中能检测出更多的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Plurality voting selects the most frequent semantic equivalence class among all sampled specifications. It can be ineffective because LLMs tend to produce correlated errors—a phenomenon observed not only across samples from the same model but even across different models ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . In challenging cases like HumanEval/135, plurality voting amplifies rather than mitigates mistakes: as shown in Figure 1 , it selects the dominant incorrect class over the correct one. Plurality voting also underuses the information in the candidate specifications, using them only to count equivalence classes. Yet a candidate need not be correct as a whole for some of its components to contribute to a correct specification: in Figure 1 , the key components of the correct specification already appear in the incorrect ones. We therefore split candidates into small pieces that, like the building bricks in Figure 1 , form a small, task-specific vocabulary. We call this process “synthesizing a language from seed formalizations”.
paragraphs.zh: 多数投票法从所有采样的规约中选出出现频率最高的语义等价类。 它可能效果不佳，因为大语言模型容易产生相关联的错误——这一现象不仅出现在同一模型的不同采样之间，甚至出现在不同模型之间（ Kim et al., 2025 ）。 在像 HumanEval/135 这样的困难案例中，多数投票法会放大而非缓解错误：如图 1 所示，它选出了占多数的错误等价类，而非正确的那个。 多数投票法也没有充分利用候选规约中的信息，仅用它们来统计等价类的数量。 然而，一个候选规约不必整体正确，其某些组成部分仍可能对正确的规约有所贡献：在图 1 中，正确规约的关键组成部分已经出现在错误的规约之中。 因此，我们把候选规约拆分成小的片段，这些片段如同图 1 中的积木，构成一个小型的、面向特定任务的词汇表。 我们将这一过程称为“从种子形式化中综合出一种语言”。

paragraphs.en: Autoformalization in a single language still suffers from correlated errors. To decorrelate them, we exploit linguistic determinism: we force the model to “think” differently by formalizing the intent in two different languages synthesized from the seeds. Figure 2 illustrates why these languages must be chosen carefully. If both are synthesized from the same seeds (top row), they may be identical, and cross-language validation reduces to plurality voting, preserving the correlated error. A natural remedy is to randomly split the seeds into two subsets and synthesize one language from each (middle row), yielding ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} and ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} . This split-seed strategy, however, fails in two ways. First, it makes the languages too different: each exposes the LLM to different fragments, so their outputs diverge. Formalizations under ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} contain no correct specification, whereas those under ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} contain seven, so no correct specification can be accepted. Second, it does not make them different enough: splitting the seeds gives no control over correlated errors, and the incorrect formalization under ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} is equivalent to seven under ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} , so the error is accepted anyway. Our ablation study ( Section 6.2 ) shows that these failures are systematic rather than specific to this example.
paragraphs.zh: 单一语言中的自动形式化仍然会受到相关性错误的影响。 为了使这些错误去相关，我们利用语言决定论：通过用从种子合成的两种不同语言来形式化意图，迫使模型以不同的方式“思考”。 图 2 说明了为什么必须谨慎选择这些语言。 如果两者都从相同的种子合成（上排），它们可能是相同的，跨语言验证就退化为多数投票，从而保留了相关性错误。 一个自然的补救方法是将种子随机分成两个子集，并从每个子集合成一种语言（中排），得到 ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} 和 ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} 。 然而，这种种子拆分策略在两个方面都会失败。 首先，它使两种语言差异过大：每种语言让大语言模型接触到不同的片段，因此它们的输出会产生分歧。 在 ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} 下的形式化不包含正确的规范，而在 ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} 下的形式化包含七个正确规范，因此无法接受任何正确的规范。 其次，它又没有使两种语言足够不同：拆分种子无法控制相关性错误，ℒ 2 ′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime} 下错误的形式化等价于 ℒ 1 ′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime} 下的七个形式化，因此错误最终还是被接受了。 我们的消融实验（第 6.2 节）表明，这些失败是系统性的，而非仅限于该示例。

paragraphs.en: These two failures suggest that the languages require a delicate balance: similar enough that correct formalizations can be matched across them, yet different enough that errors do not recur in both. We capture this balance with a property we call contrapuntality (formalized in Definition 4.2 ), which combines two requirements. Adequacy requires that both languages can express the intended specification; unlike split-seed languages, they thus offer comparable expressive power, so a correct formalization in one language has a counterpart in the other. Non-isomorphism requires that no structure-preserving translation relates formalizations across the two languages; the model therefore cannot reuse the structure of a formalization in one language when writing it in the other, making it less likely to repeat the same error in both. Here, structure refers to the shape of abstract syntax trees (ASTs): languages that differ only in vocabulary produce ASTs of the same shape for the same formula, so validating across them reduces to plurality voting.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个失败案例表明，这样的两种语言之间需要一种微妙的平衡：既要足够相似，使得正确的形式化结果能够在两者之间相互匹配；又要足够不同，使得错误不会在两者中同时出现。 我们用一个称为「对位性」（contrapuntality）的性质（在定义 4.2 中形式化）来刻画这种平衡，它包含两个要求。 充分性要求两种语言都能表达预期的规约；因此，与拆分种子语言不同，它们具有相当的表达能力，于是在一种语言中正确的形式化结果在另一种语言中也有对应物。 非同构性要求不存在任何保持结构的翻译能把两种语言间的形式化结果联系起来；因此，模型在用另一种语言书写形式化结果时无法复用前一种语言中形式化结果的结构，从而更不容易在两者中重复同样的错误。 这里的结构指的是抽象语法树（AST）的形状：仅在词汇上不同的语言会为同一个公式产生形状相同的抽象语法树，因此在它们之间进行交叉验证就退化为多数投票。

sents.en: Non-isomorphism requires that no structure-preserving translation relates formalizations across the two languages; the model therefore cannot reuse the structure of a formalization in one language when writing it in the other, making it less likely to repeat the same error in both.
sents.zh: 非同构性要求不存在任何保持结构的翻译能把两种语言间的形式化结果联系起来；因此，模型在用另一种语言书写形式化结果时无法复用前一种语言中形式化结果的结构，从而更不容易在两者中重复同样的错误。

sents.en: Here, structure refers to the shape of abstract syntax trees (ASTs): languages that differ only in vocabulary produce ASTs of the same shape for the same formula, so validating across them reduces to plurality voting.
sents.zh: 这里的结构指的是抽象语法树（AST）的形状：仅在词汇上不同的语言会为同一个公式产生形状相同的抽象语法树，因此在它们之间进行交叉验证就退化为多数投票。

paragraphs.en: With contrapuntal languages (bottom row of Figure 2 ), the example is handled correctly. On the one hand, the incorrect seeds are cut into different fragments and thus have different AST structures in the two languages, making it difficult for the same error to recur in both. On the other hand, since both languages are synthesized from all seeds, each can extract critical structures from the correct seeds—specifically, structures that prevent the LLM from unconditionally accepting r = − 1 r=-1 . For example, ℒ 1 ′′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime\prime} obtains construct 5 and ℒ 2 ′′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime\prime} obtains construct 5 ′ . Formalizations in both languages use these structures, form equivalent pairs, and are therefore accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 使用对位语言（图 2 底行）时，该示例得到了正确处理。 一方面，错误的种子被切分成不同的片段，因而在两种语言中具有不同的 AST 结构，使得同一错误难以在两者中同时复现。 另一方面，由于两种语言都是从所有种子合成的，每种语言都能从正确的种子中提取关键结构——具体而言，就是能阻止 LLM 无条件接受 r = − 1 r=-1 的结构。 例如，ℒ 1 ′′ \mathcal{L}_{1}^{\prime\prime} 获得了构造 5，而 ℒ 2 ′′ \mathcal{L}_{2}^{\prime\prime} 获得了构造 5 ′。 两种语言中的形式化都使用了这些结构，构成等价对，因此被接受。

paragraphs.en: Presenting our approach requires writing formulas in formal languages while also reasoning about these languages. We therefore distinguish the object languages , in which formulas are written, from the meta-language , in which we reason about them. Greek letters are placeholders, called meta-variables : φ , ψ , χ \varphi,\psi,\chi stand for arbitrary formulas and π , ρ \pi,\rho for arbitrary positions. All other symbols stand for themselves, with two exceptions: x x stands for an arbitrary object variable, and the names we define for particular formulas and variables, such as Def i \mathrm{Def}^{i} and c π i c^{i}_{\pi} in Section 5.2 , stand for what they name. Thus, p ⁡ ( v ) ∧ q ⁡ ( v ) p(v)\land q(v) is a concrete formula, whereas φ ∧ ψ \varphi\land\psi denotes the conjunction of the formulas that φ \varphi and ψ \psi stand for. We also distinguish three kinds of equality: = = is meta-level identity, which for formulas means identity of their syntax trees; ≐ \doteq is the equality symbol of the object language; and ≡ \equiv is semantic equivalence (defined below). For example, φ ∧ φ ≠ φ \varphi\land\varphi\neq\varphi , yet φ ∧ φ ≡ φ \varphi\land\varphi\equiv\varphi .

paragraphs.en: Our approach targets specifications written in first-order logic, the common input language of SMT solvers, standardized by SMT-LIB ( Barrett et al., 2010 ) ; this lets us check the equivalence of formalizations automatically. These formulas form the base language ℒ 0 \mathcal{L}_{0} : they are built as usual from atoms, object equality ≐ \doteq , the connectives ¬ , ∧ , ∨ , → , ↔ \lnot,\land,\lor,\rightarrow,\leftrightarrow , the constants ⊤ \top and ⊥ \bot , and the quantifiers ∀ \forall and ∃ \exists . We interpret formulas over fixed domains, such as the integers and arrays, in which function and predicate symbols have fixed meanings. The denotation ⟦ φ ⟧ \llbracket\varphi\rrbracket of a formula φ \varphi is the set of variable assignments that make φ \varphi true. For example, ⟦ r ≐ − 1 ∨ r ≥ 1 ⟧ \llbracket r\doteq-1\lor r\geq 1\rrbracket consists of the assignments that map r r to − 1 -1 or to a positive integer. For a specification whose free variables are the inputs and outputs of a program, the denotation is thus the set of input–output pairs that the specification admits. Formulas φ \varphi and ψ \psi are semantically equivalent , written φ ≡ ψ \varphi\equiv\psi , iff ⟦ φ ⟧ = ⟦ ψ ⟧ \llbracket\varphi\rrbracket=\llbracket\psi\rrbracket .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法面向用一阶逻辑编写的规约，一阶逻辑是 SMT 求解器的通用输入语言，由 SMT-LIB 标准化（Barrett et al., 2010）；这使我们能够自动检查形式化的等价性。 这些公式构成基础语言 ℒ 0 \mathcal{L}_{0}：它们照常由原子、对象相等 ≐ \doteq、连接词 ¬ , ∧ , ∨ , → , ↔ \lnot,\land,\lor,\rightarrow,\leftrightarrow、常量 ⊤ \top 和 ⊥ \bot，以及量词 ∀ \forall 和 ∃ \exists 构建而成。 我们在固定域（如整数和数组）上解释公式，其中函数符号和谓词符号具有固定的含义。 公式 φ \varphi 的指称 ⟦ φ ⟧ \llbracket\varphi\rrbracket 是使 φ \varphi 为真的变量赋值的集合。 例如，⟦ r ≐ − 1 ∨ r ≥ 1 ⟧ \llbracket r\doteq-1\lor r\geq 1\rrbracket 由将 r r 映射到 − 1 -1 或某个正整数的赋值组成。 对于自由变量是程序输入和输出的规约而言，其指称因此就是该规约所允许的输入–输出对的集合。 公式 φ \varphi 和 ψ \psi 在语义上等价，记作 φ ≡ ψ \varphi\equiv\psi，当且仅当 ⟦ φ ⟧ = ⟦ ψ ⟧ \llbracket\varphi\rrbracket=\llbracket\psi\rrbracket。

paragraphs.en: Our approach compares formulas by the shapes of their syntax trees, so we need notation for addressing the parts of a formula. A position is a finite string of positive integers: the empty string ε \varepsilon addresses the root, and π ​ i \pi i addresses the i i -th child of the node at π \pi . paragraphs.en: Finally, we define correctness for autoformalization , the translation of a natural-language specification into a formula. We write η \eta for such an informal specification and 𝑁𝐿 \mathit{NL} for the set of all of them. We do not analyze their syntax; we only assume that each η \eta has a denotation ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket : the set of variable assignments, such as input–output pairs, that the user intends (for ambiguous text, the reading the user has in mind). We write ψ ≡ η \psi\equiv\eta iff ⟦ ψ ⟧ = ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\psi\rrbracket=\llbracket\eta\rrbracket . Unlike equivalence between formulas, this cannot be checked automatically, because ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket is known only to the user.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们为自动形式化——即将自然语言规约翻译为公式——定义正确性。 我们用 η \eta 表示这样的非形式规约，用 𝑁𝐿 \mathit{NL} 表示所有这些规约的集合。 我们不分析其语法；我们只假设每个 η \eta 都有一个指称 ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket：即用户所意图的变量赋值集合，例如输入–输出对（对于有歧义的文本，指用户心中所想的那种解读）。 当 ⟦ ψ ⟧ = ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\psi\rrbracket=\llbracket\eta\rrbracket 时，我们记作 ψ ≡ η \psi\equiv\eta。 与公式之间的等价不同，这一点无法自动检验，因为 ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket 只有用户本人才知道。

paragraphs.en: As Section 2 showed, cross-checking formalizations in two languages is useful only if the languages are chosen well. First, both languages must be able to express the specification correctly; we call this adequacy . Second, the languages must differ enough that the LLM is unlikely to make the same mistake in both; we call this non-isomorphism . We refer to a pair of languages with both properties as contrapuntal , after musical counterpoint, where independent melodies combine into one harmony. In this section, we define these properties formally and then relax them to a version that can be checked automatically; Section 5 shows how to synthesize languages that satisfy it.
paragraphs.zh: 正如第 2 节所示，只有在两种语言选择得当的情况下，用两种语言交叉验证形式化才是有用的。 首先，两种语言都必须能够正确地表达规约；我们称之为充分性。 其次，两种语言必须有足够大的差异，使得大语言模型不太可能在两种语言中犯同样的错误；我们称之为非同构性。 我们将同时具备这两种性质的语言对称为对位式的，这一名称源自音乐中的对位法，即独立的旋律结合成统一的和声。 在本节中，我们正式定义这些性质，然后将它们放宽为可以自动检查的版本；第 5 节将展示如何合成满足该性质的语言。

paragraphs.en: A structure-preserving translation from χ 1 ∈ ℒ 1 \chi_{1}\in\mathcal{L}_{1} to χ 2 ∈ ℒ 2 \chi_{2}\in\mathcal{L}_{2} is a one-to-one map τ \tau from the labels of χ 1 \chi_{1} to the labels of χ 2 \chi_{2} that turns χ 1 \chi_{1} into χ 2 \chi_{2} by relabeling: Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) = Pos ⁡ ( χ 2 ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1})=\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{2}) and χ 2 ​ ( π ) = τ ⁡ ( χ 1 ​ ( π ) ) \chi_{2}(\pi)=\tau(\chi_{1}(\pi)) for every π ∈ Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) \pi\in\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1}) .
paragraphs.zh: 从 χ 1 ∈ ℒ 1 \chi_{1}\in\mathcal{L}_{1} 到 χ 2 ∈ ℒ 2 \chi_{2}\in\mathcal{L}_{2} 的保结构翻译是一个从 χ 1 \chi_{1} 的标签到 χ 2 \chi_{2} 的标签的一一映射 τ \tau ，它通过重新标注将 χ 1 \chi_{1} 变为 χ 2 \chi_{2} ：Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) = Pos ⁡ ( χ 2 ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1})=\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{2}) ，且对每个 π ∈ Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) \pi\in\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1}) 都有 χ 2 ​ ( π ) = τ ⁡ ( χ 1 ​ ( π ) ) \chi_{2}(\pi)=\tau(\chi_{1}(\pi)) 。

paragraphs.en: adequacy : both ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} and ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} are adequate for η \eta ; and
paragraphs.zh: adequacy：ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} 和 ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} 对于 η \eta 都是充分的；并且

paragraphs.en: non-isomorphism : no formula in Real ℒ 1 ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{1}}(\eta) has a structure-preserving translation to a formula in Real ℒ 2 ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{2}}(\eta) .
paragraphs.zh: 非同构：Real ℒ 1 ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{1}}(\eta) 中没有任何公式能够以保持结构的方式翻译为 Real ℒ 2 ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{2}}(\eta) 中的公式。

paragraphs.en: Definition 4.2 captures our intuition, but it cannot be checked algorithmically, for two reasons. First, both clauses refer to realization sets, and hence to ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket , which is known only to the user. Second, even with known semantics, non-isomorphism requires proving that synthesizing a translation is unrealizable , which is undecidable in general ( Hu et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 定义 4.2 刻画了我们的直观理解，但由于两个原因，它无法通过算法来检验。 首先，两个条款都涉及实现集，因而都涉及 ⟦ η ⟧ \llbracket\eta\rrbracket ，而只有用户自己才知道它。 其次，即使语义已知，非同构也需要证明综合出一个翻译是不可实现的，而这在一般情况下是不可判定的（Hu et al., 2019）。

paragraphs.en: We make the problem tractable by weakening it in two ways. First, in place of the inaccessible semantics of η \eta , we use a finite set of seed formalizations : candidate formalizations of η \eta sampled from the LLM in the base language. The seeds stand for the candidate meanings of η \eta —the intended formalization together with its plausible near-miss variants. Second, we restrict the synthesized languages to syntactic sugar over the base language, and constrain only the sugarings of the seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种方式弱化该问题，使其变得可处理。 首先，我们用一组有限的种子形式化替代不可获取的 η \eta 的语义：种子形式化是从大语言模型中以基础语言采样的 η \eta 的候选形式化。 种子代表 η \eta 的候选含义——即预期的形式化及其可能的近似错误变体。 其次，我们将被综合的语言限制为基础语言之上的语法糖，并且只约束种子的加糖结果。

paragraphs.en: The two definitions differ only in replacing the realization sets Real ℒ i ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{i}}(\eta) , which contain all formulas equivalent to the intent, with the sugaring sets Sug ℒ i ​ ( ψ ) \mathrm{Sug}_{\mathcal{L}_{i}}(\psi) , which contain only the formulas that reproduce the syntax of the seed. Unlike realization sets, sugaring sets are finite and computable for a finite alphabet: every construct covers at least one node of ψ \psi , so a sugaring of ψ \psi is never larger than ψ \psi itself. Whether a translation maps one given formula to another is decided by comparing the two trees position by position. Effective contrapuntality is therefore decidable.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个定义的区别仅在于，将包含所有与意图等价的公式的实现集 Real ℒ i ​ ( η ) \mathrm{Real}_{\mathcal{L}_{i}}(\eta) 替换为只包含再现种子语法结构的公式的语法糖集 Sug ℒ i ​ ( ψ ) \mathrm{Sug}_{\mathcal{L}_{i}}(\psi) 。 与实现集不同，语法糖集在有限字母表上是有限且可计算的：每个构造至少覆盖 ψ \psi 的一个节点，因此 ψ \psi 的语法糖永远不会大于 ψ \psi 本身。 一个翻译是否将某个给定公式映射为另一个公式，是通过逐位置比较这两棵树来判定的。 因此，有效对位性是可判定的。

paragraphs.en: This section solves the synthesis problem : given the seed set Ψ \Psi , find a pair of sugared languages that is effectively contrapuntal for Ψ \Psi . Rather than reasoning about structure-preserving translations between all pairs of sugarings of every seed, our method enforces a simpler and more conservative requirement: that no two sugarings of a seed have the same shape .
paragraphs.zh: 本节解决综合问题：给定种子集 Ψ \Psi ，找到一对在 Ψ \Psi 上有效形成对位的加糖语言。 我们的方法不再对每个种子的所有加糖形式之间的保结构翻译进行逐一推理，而是采用一个更简单、更保守的要求：任何种子的两个加糖形式不得具有相同的形状（shape）。

sents.en: This section solves the synthesis problem : given the seed set Ψ \Psi , find a pair of sugared languages that is effectively contrapuntal for Ψ \Psi .
sents.zh: 本节解决综合问题：给定种子集 Ψ \Psi ，找到一对在 Ψ \Psi 上有效形成对位的加糖语言。

sents.en: Rather than reasoning about structure-preserving translations between all pairs of sugarings of every seed, our method enforces a simpler and more conservative requirement: that no two sugarings of a seed have the same shape .
sents.zh: 我们的方法不再对每个种子的所有加糖形式之间的保结构翻译进行逐一推理，而是采用一个更简单、更保守的要求：任何种子的两个加糖形式不得具有相同的形状（shape）。

paragraphs.en: The shape of a formula χ \chi is its set of positions Pos ⁡ ( χ ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi) ; formulas χ 1 ∈ ℒ 1 \chi_{1}\in\mathcal{L}_{1} and χ 2 ∈ ℒ 2 \chi_{2}\in\mathcal{L}_{2} have the same shape iff Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) = Pos ⁡ ( χ 2 ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1})=\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{2}) —that is, their trees are identical up to labels.
paragraphs.zh: 公式 χ \chi 的形状（shape）是其位置集合 Pos ⁡ ( χ ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi) ；公式 χ 1 ∈ ℒ 1 \chi_{1}\in\mathcal{L}_{1} 与 χ 2 ∈ ℒ 2 \chi_{2}\in\mathcal{L}_{2} 具有相同的形状，当且仅当 Pos ⁡ ( χ 1 ) = Pos ⁡ ( χ 2 ) \mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{1})=\mathrm{Pos}(\chi_{2}) ——也就是说，它们的树在除去标签后是完全相同的。

paragraphs.en: Formulas related by a structure-preserving translation have the same shape, but not conversely: p ⁡ ( u ) ∧ p ⁡ ( v ) p(u)\land p(v) and p ⁡ ( u ) ∧ q ⁡ ( v ) p(u)\land q(v) have the same shape, yet no translation relates them, since it would have to map p p to both p p and q q . Forbidding same-shaped sugarings therefore entails clause (ii) of Definition 4.3 , and avoids quantifying over symbol maps: whether two sugarings have the same shape depends only on their positions, which Section 5.2 encodes as quantifier-free constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 通过保持结构的翻译相互关联的公式具有相同的形状，但反之不然：p(u) ∧ p(v) 与 p(u) ∧ q(v) 具有相同的形状，却没有翻译能把它们关联起来，因为这样的翻译必须同时把 p 映射到 p 和 q。 因此，禁止相同形状的糖化蕴含定义 4.3 的条款 (ii)，并且避免对符号映射进行量化：两个糖化是否具有相同的形状仅取决于它们的位置，而第 5.2 节将这些位置编码为无量词约束。

sents.en: Forbidding same-shaped sugarings therefore entails clause (ii) of Definition 4.3 , and avoids quantifying over symbol maps: whether two sugarings have the same shape depends only on their positions, which Section 5.2 encodes as quantifier-free constraints.
sents.zh: 因此，禁止相同形状的糖化蕴含定义 4.3 的条款 (ii)，并且避免对符号映射进行量化：两个糖化是否具有相同的形状仅取决于它们的位置，而第 5.2 节将这些位置编码为无量词约束。

paragraphs.en: Our method searches over cuts of the seed trees. A cut of a formula is a non-root position π \pi ; it severs the edge above the subtree at π \pi . A cut set C ⊆ Pos ⁡ ( ψ ) ∖ { ε } C\subseteq\mathrm{Pos}(\psi)\setminus\{\varepsilon\} partitions the tree into fragments , one rooted at ε \varepsilon and one at each cut, each extending downward until it meets a cut or a leaf. It thereby determines a sugar: each fragment becomes the definition of a construct, with its cuts as holes, and the resulting fragment tree is a sugared formula that desugars to the seed (Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法在种子树的割上进行搜索。 一个公式的割是一个非根位置 π \pi ；它切断位于 π \pi 处的子树之上的边。 一个割集 C ⊆ Pos ⁡ ( ψ ) ∖ { ε } C\subseteq\mathrm{Pos}(\psi)\setminus\{\varepsilon\} 将树分割成若干片段，一个以 ε \varepsilon 为根，其余各自以一个割为根，每个片段向下延伸，直到遇到某个割或叶子为止。 由此它确定一个语法糖：每个片段成为一个构造的定义，其割作为洞，所得的片段树是一个可脱糖还原为种子的加糖公式（图 4 ）。

sents.zh: 我们的方法在种子树的割上进行搜索。

paragraphs.en: The algorithm grows the two languages by adding constructs. An extension for a seed ψ \psi over a pair ( ℒ 1 , ℒ 2 ) (\mathcal{L}_{1},\mathcal{L}_{2}) is a pair δ = ( Δ ​ ℒ 1 , Δ ​ ℒ 2 ) \delta=(\Delta\mathcal{L}_{1},\Delta\mathcal{L}_{2}) of sets of fresh constructs, obtained from two cut sets of ψ \psi whose fragment trees differ in shape: Δ ​ ℒ i \Delta\mathcal{L}_{i} defines every fragment of the i i -th cut set not already in ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} , so that its fragment tree is an ( ℒ i ∪ Δ ​ ℒ i ) (\mathcal{L}_{i}\cup\Delta\mathcal{L}_{i}) -formula desugaring to ψ \psi . Extending thus only adds constructs and never changes existing definitions. Algorithm 1 is a backtracking fold over the seeds: each invocation of Synth integrates the head of the list S S of remaining seeds by one extension and recurses on the tail, keeping its own set B B of extensions it has tried and rejected; P P is the set of integrated seeds, and both languages start empty.
paragraphs.zh: 该算法通过添加构造来扩展两种语言。 种子 ψ \psi 在语言对 ( ℒ 1 , ℒ 2 ) (\mathcal{L}_{1},\mathcal{L}_{2}) 上的一个扩展是一对新构造集合 δ = ( Δ ​ ℒ 1 , Δ ​ ℒ 2 ) \delta=(\Delta\mathcal{L}_{1},\Delta\mathcal{L}_{2}) ，它来自 ψ \psi 的两个片段树形状不同的切集： Δ ​ ℒ i \Delta\mathcal{L}_{i} 定义第 i i 个切集中所有尚不在 ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} 中的片段，使得其片段树是一个脱糖后得到 ψ \psi 的 ( ℒ i ∪ Δ ​ ℒ i ) (\mathcal{L}_{i}\cup\Delta\mathcal{L}_{i}) -公式。 这样扩展只会添加构造，绝不会改变已有的定义。 算法 1 是对种子进行回溯折叠：每次调用 Synth 都通过一次扩展整合剩余种子列表 S S 的头部，并对尾部递归，同时维护其自身已尝试并拒绝的扩展集合 B B ； P P 是已整合的种子集合，两种语言初始均为空。

paragraphs.en: The algorithm uses two subroutines. Cut ​ ( ψ , ℒ 1 , ℒ 2 , B ) \textsc{Cut}(\psi,\mathcal{L}_{1},\mathcal{L}_{2},B) returns an extension for ψ \psi over ( ℒ 1 , ℒ 2 ) (\mathcal{L}_{1},\mathcal{L}_{2}) that is not in B B , or 𝗇𝗈𝗇𝖾 \mathsf{none} once its search space is exhausted (Section 5.3 ). FindIso ​ ( Ψ ′ , ℒ 1 , ℒ 2 ) \textsc{FindIso}(\Psi^{\prime},\mathcal{L}_{1},\mathcal{L}_{2}) returns a witness ( ψ ′ , χ 1 , χ 2 ) (\psi^{\prime},\chi_{1},\chi_{2}) , consisting of a seed ψ ′ ∈ Ψ ′ \psi^{\prime}\in\Psi^{\prime} and same-shaped sugarings χ 1 ∈ Sug ℒ 1 ​ ( ψ ′ ) \chi_{1}\in\mathrm{Sug}_{\mathcal{L}_{1}}(\psi^{\prime}) and χ 2 ∈ Sug ℒ 2 ​ ( ψ ′ ) \chi_{2}\in\mathrm{Sug}_{\mathcal{L}_{2}}(\psi^{\prime}) , or 𝗇𝗈𝗇𝖾 \mathsf{none} if there is none (Section 5.3 ). This check is needed because an extension guarantees different shapes only for the two fragment trees it was built from: constructs may recombine into other sugarings of a seed, as γ → \gamma_{\rightarrow} recombines with β p \beta_{p} in Example 4.4 . New constructs can create such recombinations for earlier seeds too, so line 15 rechecks every integrated seed.
paragraphs.zh: 该算法使用两个子例程。 Cut(ψ, ℒ₁, ℒ₂, B) 返回一个针对 ψ 在 (ℒ₁, ℒ₂) 上的、不属于 B 的扩展，当其搜索空间耗尽时返回 none（见 5.3 节）。 FindIso(Ψ′, ℒ₁, ℒ₂) 返回一个见证 (ψ′, χ₁, χ₂)，它由一个种子 ψ′ ∈ Ψ′ 以及同形的糖化 χ₁ ∈ Sug_ℒ₁(ψ′) 和 χ₂ ∈ Sug_ℒ₂(ψ′) 组成；若不存在这样的见证则返回 none（见 5.3 节）。 之所以需要这一检查，是因为一个扩展仅对构建它所依据的两棵片段树保证形状不同：各个构造可能会重新组合成某个种子的其他糖化，如例 4.4 中 γ→ 与 β_p 的重新组合。 新的构造也可能为较早的种子造成这样的重新组合，因此第 15 行会对每个已被整合的种子重新进行检查。

paragraphs.en: An extension is blocked (line 20 ) either because it violates the shape constraint, when FindIso returns a witness, or because it is a dead end, when the recursive call finds no completion over the remaining seeds; the loop then asks Cut for another extension. Since B B is local to the invocation, it starts empty whenever the languages are extended and is restored on backtracking.
paragraphs.zh: 当 FindIso 返回一个见证时，扩展因违反形状约束而被阻塞（第 20 行）；当递归调用在剩余种子上找不到任何补全时，扩展则是死路；随后循环让 Cut 请求另一个扩展。 由于 B B 是本次调用的局部变量，每当语言被扩展时它都从空开始，并在回溯时被恢复。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows two cut sets that cut the same seed in unrelated places, yet yield fragment trees of the same shape. What matters is not where the cuts lie but how they nest: the holes of a fragment are its dominating cuts, those below its root with no other cut in between. At the root, C 1 C_{1} has the dominating cuts 11 11 and 21 21 (with 211 211 below 21 21 ), and C 2 C_{2} has 21 21 and 22 22 (with 221 221 below 22 22 ), so both top constructs have two holes. The constraints below capture this condition node by node.

paragraphs.en: Our experiments address the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验旨在回答以下研究问题：

paragraphs.en: How effective are contrapuntal languages at validating autoformalized specifications compared with baselines?
paragraphs.zh: 与基线相比，对位语言在验证自动形式化规约方面有多有效？

paragraphs.en: (Ablation) How does contrapuntality affect the validation performance?
paragraphs.zh: （消融实验）对位性如何影响验证性能？

paragraphs.en: Do contrapuntal languages help mitigate correlated errors?
paragraphs.zh: 对位法语言是否有助于缓解相关性错误？

paragraphs.en: What is the token cost of contrapuntal languages in comparison with baselines?
paragraphs.zh: 与基线相比，对位语言的 token 成本是多少？

paragraphs.zh: 对位语言失败的原因有哪些？

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on two programming benchmarks. The first is HumanEval+ (HEP) ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , whose tasks provide a natural-language description, a Python signature, a reference implementation, and tests. Although LLMs solve most HumanEval+ tasks, prior studies show that generating behaviorally correct specifications for HumanEval remains challenging even when expressed as Python postconditions and contracts ( Endres et al., 2024 ; Richter and Wehrheim, 2025 ) . Our results show that this challenge persists when formalizing these tasks in SMT-LIB: even with reasoning enabled, Qwen3.6-Flash achieves an average pass@30 below 50%. For testing, we use HumanEval+-mini ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , which EvalPlus derives from the full suite by a greedy set cover that preserves branch coverage, mutant killing, and the detection of incorrect LLM-generated programs. It is about 47 × 47\times smaller with similar testing effectiveness, which substantially reduces the cost of SMT queries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个编程基准上进行评估。 第一个是 HumanEval+（HEP）（Liu et al., 2023），其任务提供了自然语言描述、Python 函数签名、参考实现和测试用例。 尽管大语言模型能解决大部分 HumanEval+ 任务，但先前的研究表明，即使以 Python 后置条件和契约的形式表达，为 HumanEval 生成行为正确的规约仍然具有挑战性（Endres et al., 2024；Richter and Wehrheim, 2025）。 我们的结果表明，当用 SMT-LIB 形式化这些任务时，这一挑战依然存在：即使启用了推理，Qwen3.6-Flash 的平均 pass@30 也低于 50%。 在测试方面，我们使用 HumanEval+-mini（Liu et al., 2023），它由 EvalPlus 从完整测试套件中通过贪心集合覆盖方法推导而来，同时保留了分支覆盖、变异杀灭以及对不正确的大语言模型生成程序的检测能力。 它的规模大约小 47 × 47\times 倍，而测试效果相近，从而大幅降低了 SMT 查询的成本。

paragraphs.en: The second is LiveCodeBench (LCB) ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , whose competitive programming problems from AtCoder and LeetCode are substantially harder to formalize. Applying the same test-suite reduction, we construct LiveCodeBench-mini: 727 of the original 7,000 tests across 175 tasks (463 public and 264 private), which still exercise all 6,340 branch arcs covered by the validated reference implementations and detect all 2,587 functionally exposed mutants considered during test selection.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate using three LLM settings. GPT-5.4 mini is a compact proprietary OpenAI model with strong coding, reasoning, and tool-use capabilities. Qwen3.6-Flash is a fast-serving model in Qwen family, which includes open-weight releases and emphasizes multilingual coding. This model supports both thinking mode enabled and thinking mode disabled . We conducted experiments under these two modes, respectively.

paragraphs.en: For each task, we prompt the LLM with the task description, function signature, and types to generate an SMT-LIB v2 specification. It declares constants for the arguments and return values and contains two named assertions: pre_condition , for valid inputs, and post_condition , for the input–output relation. Since we focus on validating autoformalized specifications: deciding which candidates to accept when no external correctness oracle is available, we therefore compare three such strategies using the same sampling budget of 30 LLM-generated responses per task, and include direct generation as a reference to assess the effect of validation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们向大语言模型提供任务描述、函数签名和类型作为提示，以生成 SMT-LIB v2 规范。 该规范为参数和返回值声明常量，并包含两个命名的断言：pre_condition，用于有效输入；post_condition，用于输入–输出关系。 由于我们专注于验证自动形式化生成的规范：即在没有外部正确性基准可用时决定接受哪些候选，因此我们在每个任务使用相同的 30 个大语言模型生成响应的采样预算下比较三种此类策略，并纳入直接生成作为参照，以评估验证的效果。

sents.en: For each task, we prompt the LLM with the task description, function signature, and types to generate an SMT-LIB v2 specification.
sents.zh: 对于每个任务，我们向大语言模型提供任务描述、函数签名和类型作为提示，以生成 SMT-LIB v2 规范。

sents.en: It declares constants for the arguments and return values and contains two named assertions: pre_condition , for valid inputs, and post_condition , for the input–output relation.
sents.zh: 该规范为参数和返回值声明常量，并包含两个命名的断言：pre_condition，用于有效输入；post_condition，用于输入–输出关系。

sents.en: Since we focus on validating autoformalized specifications: deciding which candidates to accept when no external correctness oracle is available, we therefore compare three such strategies using the same sampling budget of 30 LLM-generated responses per task, and include direct generation as a reference to assess the effect of validation.
sents.zh: 由于我们专注于验证自动形式化生成的规范：即在没有外部正确性基准可用时决定接受哪些候选，因此我们在每个任务使用相同的 30 个大语言模型生成响应的采样预算下比较三种此类策略，并纳入直接生成作为参照，以评估验证的效果。

paragraphs.en: Direct generation keeps all n = 30 n=30 samples that pass basic validity checks, i.e., follow the pre-/postcondition structure and parse in Z3 (We discuss the choice of n n in supplementary materials).
paragraphs.zh: 直接生成保留了所有通过基本有效性检查的 n = 30 n=30 个样本，即符合前/后置条件结构并且能在 Z3 中解析的样本（我们在补充材料中讨论 n n 的选择）。

paragraphs.en: Plurality voting follows the Symbolic Equivalence strategy ( Li et al., 2024 ) , clusters these specifications by pairwise SMT equivalence and selects the largest class.
paragraphs.zh: plurality voting（多数投票）遵循 Symbolic Equivalence（符号等价）策略（Li et al., 2024），通过成对 SMT 等价性对这些规格说明进行聚类，并选择最大的类别。

paragraphs.en: Round-trip veri. follows the round-trip verification strategy ( Amrollahi et al., 2026 ) , translating each of n = 10 n=10 valid seeds into natural language and back into SMT-LIB. It retains only seeds proven SMT-equivalent to their regenerated counterparts, which serve solely as verification artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 往返验证遵循往返验证策略（Amrollahi et al., 2026），将 n=10 个有效种子中的每一个翻译成自然语言，再翻译回 SMT-LIB。 它只保留被证明与其再生成副本在 SMT 上等价的种子，这些种子仅作为验证产物使用。

sents.en: Round-trip veri. follows the round-trip verification strategy ( Amrollahi et al., 2026 ) , translating each of n = 10 n=10 valid seeds into natural language and back into SMT-LIB.
sents.zh: 往返验证遵循往返验证策略（Amrollahi et al., 2026），将 n=10 个有效种子中的每一个翻译成自然语言，再翻译回 SMT-LIB。

sents.en: It retains only seeds proven SMT-equivalent to their regenerated counterparts, which serve solely as verification artifacts.
sents.zh: 它只保留被证明与其再生成副本在 SMT 上等价的种子，这些种子仅作为验证产物使用。

paragraphs.en: Contrapuntal langs. synthesizes a pair of contrapuntal languages from n = 10 n=10 valid seeds and generates m = 10 m=10 specifications in each language; a candidate is kept if it passes the validity checks, uses the constructs of its language, and is proven equivalent to a candidate from the other language.
paragraphs.zh: 对位语言（Contrapuntal langs.）从 n = 10 n=10 个有效种子中合成一对对位语言，并在每种语言中生成 m = 10 m=10 个规范；若候选方案通过有效性检查、使用其所属语言的构造，并能被证明与来自另一种语言的候选方案等价，则予以保留。

paragraphs.en: To assess soundness, we need incorrect programs, called mutants, whose outputs a sound specification must reject. Since HumanEval+ provides no incorrect programs, we prompt GPT-5.5 with the canonical solution to produce distinct single-bug variants, targeting five per task; for LiveCodeBench, we combine real wrong-answer submissions with at least five GPT-5.5 variants of a validated correct submission. We discard candidates that are syntactically invalid, lack the required entry point, or duplicate others, and run the rest on the benchmark tests. A mutant yields a negative example only when it returns a value different from the reference output; exceptions and resource failures yield no input–output pair to check against a specification and are ignored. This gives 779 mutants for HumanEval+ (161 tasks, 4.84 per task) and 2,587 for LiveCodeBench (175 tasks, 14.78 per task: 1,618 real submissions and 969 generated variants).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估可靠性，我们需要错误的程序（称为变异体），可靠规格说明必须拒绝其输出。由于 HumanEval+ 不提供错误程序，我们向 GPT-5.5 提供规范解法并提示其生成不同的单缺陷变体，每个任务目标为五个；对于 LiveCodeBench，我们将真实的错误答案提交与至少五个基于已验证正确提交的 GPT-5.5 变体相结合。我们丢弃语法无效、缺少所需入口点或与其他重复的候选程序，并在基准测试上运行其余程序。只有当变异体返回的值与参考输出不同时，它才会产生一个负样本；异常和资源失败不会产生可与规格说明进行对照检查的输入–输出对，因此被忽略。这为 HumanEval+ 提供了 779 个变异体（161 个任务，平均每个任务 4.84 个），为 LiveCodeBench 提供了 2,587 个变异体（175 个任务，平均每个任务 14.78 个：1,618 个真实提交和 969 个生成变体）。

paragraphs.en: Neither benchmark provides reference formal specifications, so, following prior behavioral evaluations ( Endres et al., 2024 ; Richter and Wehrheim, 2025 ; Prasetya et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate specifications on input–output pairs: positive tests from reference executions and negative tests from mutant outputs, all with inputs valid for their tasks. For each pair, Z3 checks whether the specification’s pre- and postconditions, with the variables bound to the pair, are satisfiable, that is, whether the specification admits the pair. A positive test passes if its pair is admitted; rejecting it, including through the precondition, is a completeness failure. A negative test kills its mutant if the pair is rejected while the input satisfies the precondition, so that an overly restrictive precondition does not count as a kill. A mutant is killed if any of its negative tests kills it, and a specification is sound if it kills every mutant.
paragraphs.zh: 两个基准均未提供参考形式规范，因此，参照先前的行为评估（Endres et al., 2024；Richter and Wehrheim, 2025；Prasetya et al., 2026），我们在输入–输出对上评估规范：正测试来自参考执行的输出，负测试来自变异体的输出，所有输入对其任务均有效。 对于每一对，Z3 检查规范的 precondition 和 postcondition（变量绑定到该输入–输出对时）是否可满足，即规范是否接受该输入–输出对。 如果正测试的输入–输出对被接受，则该测试通过；拒绝它（包括通过 precondition 拒绝）属于完备性失败。 如果负测试的输入–输出对在输入满足 precondition 的条件下被拒绝，则该负测试杀死其变异体，这样过于严格的 precondition 不会被算作杀死。 如果变异体的任一负测试杀死了它，则该变异体被杀死；如果规范杀死了所有变异体，则该规范是可靠的。

paragraphs.en: Since the solver may time out, we use a threshold τ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tau\in[0,1] : a specification is τ \tau -complete if no positive test fails, at least a fraction τ \tau pass, and the rest return unknown . An unknown result counts as neither a pass nor a kill; errored or unsupported cases are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 由于求解器可能超时，我们使用阈值 τ∈[0,1]：如果一个规约没有阳性测试失败，且至少有比例 τ 的测试通过，其余返回 unknown，则称该规约为 τ-完全的。 unknown 结果既不算通过也不算杀死；出错或不支持的用例被排除在外。

sents.zh: 由于求解器可能超时，我们使用阈值 τ∈[0,1]：如果一个规约没有阳性测试失败，且至少有比例 τ 的测试通过，其余返回 unknown，则称该规约为 τ-完全的。

paragraphs.en: Reporting either completeness or soundness alone for specifications accepted under different methods can be misleading, since a specification may trivially favor completeness by accepting all behaviors, or favor soundness by rejecting all behaviors. We therefore report two joint metrics: MKR ∣ \mid C denotes the percentage of evaluated mutants killed by accepted specifications that are τ \tau -complete; CR denotes the empirical correctness rate: the percentage of accepted specifications that are both τ \tau -complete and sound (able to kill all evaluated mutants). Their task-level macro-averages are denoted by Avg. MKR ∣ \mid C and Avg. CR, respectively. paragraphs.en: The results above cover only tasks with an accepted specification. We therefore also report task coverage , the fraction of tasks with at least one accepted specification. For reference, we also report seed availability , the fraction of tasks whose initial seed pool contains at least one complete and sound specification. This is an upper bound on the fraction of tasks any method can accept correctly. Seed availability is 39.17% on HEP and 12.97% on LCB. Our method covers 29.81% and 8.76%, round-trip validation 64.60% and 52.00%, and plurality voting 73.27% and 48.77%. Both baselines exceed seed availability by a wide margin, so they must accept incorrect specifications for many tasks. Our coverage is lower than theirs, but it is the closest to seed availability on both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 上述结果仅涵盖具有已接受规范的任务。 因此，我们还报告任务覆盖率，即至少具有一个已接受规范的任务所占的比例。 作为参考，我们还报告种子可用率，即初始种子池中至少包含一个完整且可靠规范的任务所占的比例。 这是任何方法能够正确接受的任务比例的上限。 种子可用率在 HEP 上为 39.17%，在 LCB 上为 12.97%。 我们的方法分别覆盖 29.81% 和 8.76%，往返验证分别为 64.60% 和 52.00%，多数投票分别为 73.27% 和 48.77%。 两种基线方法都大幅超过种子可用率，因此它们必然对许多任务接受了错误的规范。 我们的覆盖率低于它们，但在两个基准上都最接近种子可用率。

paragraphs.en: Overall, specifications accepted by contrapuntal languages kill the most mutants and are most often correct. Our method rejects more tasks than the baselines, but its coverage is the closest to the upper bound on correct acceptance. This conservatism matters for verification: an incorrect specification can let a buggy program pass verification, whereas a rejected task is simply flagged as unresolved. Contrapuntal languages thus offer the best balance between reliability and coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，对位式语言所接受的规约杀死的变异体最多，且正确率最高。 我们的方法拒绝的任务比基线方法更多，但其覆盖率最接近正确接受的上界。 这种保守性对验证至关重要：错误的规约可能让有缺陷的程序通过验证，而被拒绝的任务只是被标记为未解决。 因此，对位式语言在可靠性与覆盖率之间提供了最佳平衡。

paragraphs.en: To assess the contribution of contrapuntality to the effectiveness of our method, we compare our approach with a relaxed version. This variant randomly partitions the sampled seed formalizations into two disjoint subsets of equal size and synthesizes one language independently from each subset, breaking contrapuntality guarantee between two languages. Relative to Algorithm 1 , it removes the requirement that both languages express every seed, the different-shape constraint in Cut , and the FindIso check and its associated rejection of candidate extensions. We retain the same subsequent formalization and equivalence checking procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估对位性对我们方法有效性的贡献，我们将我们的方法与一个放宽版本进行比较。 该变体将采样得到的种子形式化随机划分为两个大小相等的不相交子集，并从每个子集独立地综合出一种语言，从而破坏了两种语言之间的对位性保证。 相对于算法 1，它移除了两种语言都必须表达每个种子的要求、Cut 中的不同形状约束，以及 FindIso 检查及其对候选扩展的相关拒绝机制。 我们保留了相同的后续形式化与等价性检查流程。

paragraphs.en: Contrapuntal languages are intended to decorrelate errors: two incorrect formalizations in different languages should be less likely to be incorrect in the same way. We test this by comparing single-language pairs (two specifications generated directly in SMT-LIB) with cross-language pairs (one specification from each contrapuntal language). For each pair type, we measure error coincidence (EC): among pairs of incorrect specifications, the fraction that are semantically equivalent.
paragraphs.zh: 对位式语言旨在使错误去相关：在不同语言中出现的两个错误形式化，以相同方式出错的可能性应当更低。 我们通过比较单语言对（直接在 SMT-LIB 中生成的两个规约）与跨语言对（每个规约分别来自一种对位式语言）来检验这一点。 对于每种配对类型，我们测量错误重合率（EC）：在错误的规约对中，语义等价的规约对所占的比例。

sents.en: Contrapuntal languages are intended to decorrelate errors: two incorrect formalizations in different languages should be less likely to be incorrect in the same way.
sents.zh: 对位式语言旨在使错误去相关：在不同语言中出现的两个错误形式化，以相同方式出错的可能性应当更低。

sents.en: We test this by comparing single-language pairs (two specifications generated directly in SMT-LIB) with cross-language pairs (one specification from each contrapuntal language).
sents.zh: 我们通过比较单语言对（直接在 SMT-LIB 中生成的两个规约）与跨语言对（每个规约分别来自一种对位式语言）来检验这一点。

sents.en: For each pair type, we measure error coincidence (EC): among pairs of incorrect specifications, the fraction that are semantically equivalent.
sents.zh: 对于每种配对类型，我们测量错误重合率（EC）：在错误的规约对中，语义等价的规约对所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: For each task and model setting, we consider the valid specifications among the 30 direct-generation samples and the valid candidates generated in each contrapuntal language before equivalence-based acceptance. We group candidates into solver-confirmed equivalence classes using the same SMT-based equivalence-checking procedure as in Section 6.1 . A class is labeled incorrect if a member rejects a reference input–output pair or an evaluated mutant is confirmed to survive its checks. Otherwise, it is labeled correct if a member meets the 0.8 0.8 -completeness and soundness criteria used in RQ1. Classes without sufficient evidence for either label are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务和模型设置，我们考虑30个直接生成样本中的有效规约，以及在基于等价的接受之前每个对位语言中生成的有效候选。 我们使用与6.1节相同的基于SMT的等价性检查过程，将候选划分为求解器确认的等价类。 如果某个类中的成员拒绝了某个参考输入–输出对，或某个被评估的变异体被确认通过了其检查，则该类被标记为错误。 否则，如果某个类中的成员满足RQ1中使用的0.8 0.8完备性和可靠性标准，则该类被标记为正确。 没有足够证据支持任一标签的类将被排除。

sents.en: For each task and model setting, we consider the valid specifications among the 30 direct-generation samples and the valid candidates generated in each contrapuntal language before equivalence-based acceptance.

sents.en: We group candidates into solver-confirmed equivalence classes using the same SMT-based equivalence-checking procedure as in Section 6.1 .

sents.en: A class is labeled incorrect if a member rejects a reference input–output pair or an evaluated mutant is confirmed to survive its checks.
sents.zh: 如果某个类中的成员拒绝了某个参考输入–输出对，或某个被评估的变异体被确认通过了其检查，则该类被标记为错误。

sents.en: Otherwise, it is labeled correct if a member meets the 0.8 0.8 -completeness and soundness criteria used in RQ1.

sents.en: Classes without sufficient evidence for either label are excluded.

paragraphs.en: For the single-language comparison, we form unordered pairs of distinct SMT-LIB candidates; for the cross language comparison, we pair one candidate from each contrapuntal language. paragraphs.en: Averaging EC equally across the three model settings, the rate decreases from 25.23% for single-language pairs to 21.88% for cross-language pairs on HumanEval+, and from 10.07% to 5.72% on LiveCodeBench. Thus, when both candidates are incorrect, cross-language pairs agree on the same incorrect semantics less frequently on average. These results provide empirical support for using contrapuntal representations to decorrelate model errors for more effective validation of autoformalizaed specifications, beyond enforcing differences in AST shape.
paragraphs.zh: 将 EC 在三种模型设置上平均后，错误率在 HumanEval+ 上从单语言对的 25.23% 降至跨语言对的 21.88%，在 LiveCodeBench 上从 10.07% 降至 5.72%。 因此，当两个候选答案都错误时，跨语言对平均而言更少在相同的错误语义上达成一致。 这些结果为使用对位表征来去相关模型错误、从而更有效地验证自动形式化规范提供了实证支持，其作用超越了仅仅强制 AST 形状上的差异。

paragraphs.en: All three methods consume more tokens on LCB than on HEP, consistent with its more complex task descriptions and specifications. Round-trip verification consumes fewer tokens than plurality voting because of shorter prompts and condensed task descriptions. Compared with plurality voting, contrapuntal languages consume more input tokens because their prompts include the synthesized language constructs and instructions for using them, also yielding more compact outputs. Their more compact outputs generally do not offset the larger input completely.
paragraphs.zh: 三种方法在 LCB 上的 token 消耗都高于 HEP，这与 LCB 的任务描述和规范更为复杂相一致。 由于提示词更短、任务描述更精炼，往返验证比多数投票消耗更少的 token。 与多数投票相比，对位语言消耗更多的输入 token，因为其提示词包含合成的语言结构及其使用说明，同时也产生更紧凑的输出。 其更紧凑的输出通常不能完全抵消更大的输入开销。

paragraphs.en: On average, contrapuntal languages consume 1.4 × 1.4\times as many tokens as plurality voting and 2.5 × 2.5\times as many as round-trip verification, using the additional context to induce structurally different representations. This trade-off yields the higher validation performance demonstrated in Section 6.1 by addressing correlated errors that additional sampling alone does not remove.
paragraphs.zh: 平均而言，对位法语言消耗的词元数量是多数投票的 1.4 × 1.4\times 倍，是往返验证的 2.5 × 2.5\times 倍，并利用这些额外的上下文来诱导结构性不同的表示。 这种权衡通过解决仅靠额外采样无法消除的相关错误，带来了第 6.1 节所展示的更高验证性能。

paragraphs.en: Across the two benchmarks and three model settings, contrapuntal languages’ false-positive failures accounted for 38.9% of all 216 failures. Although we introduce representational diversity between contrapuntal languages, the two languages still share the same seed formalizations and therefore cannot eliminate correlated errors completely. After investigation, most false-positive cases lacked any 0.8 0.8 -complete and sound specification among seed formalizations, and among tasks with at least two valid seeds, these cases exhibited approximately 15% lower normalized equivalence-class entropy than other tasks that lacked such a seed specification, suggesting a more concentrated distribution of incorrect interpretations that may be more difficult to decorrelate even when formalizations are required to use structurally different representations.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个基准和三种模型设置下，对位语言的假阳性失败占全部 216 个失败的 38.9%。 尽管我们在对位语言之间引入了表征多样性，但这两种语言仍然共享相同的种子形式化，因此无法完全消除相关错误。 经调查发现，大多数假阳性案例在种子形式化中缺少任何 0.8 0.8 -完备且可靠的规范，而在拥有至少两个有效种子的任务中，这些案例的归一化等价类熵比缺少此类种子规范的其他任务低约 15%，这表明错误解释的分布更加集中，即使要求形式化使用结构上不同的表征，也可能更难以去相关。

paragraphs.en: False-negative failures accounted for the remaining 61.1%. These comprised cases with no valid specifications under one or both languages (20.8%), cases with valid specifications but no matching pairs between the two languages (31.5%), and failures to synthesize languages satisfying contrapuntality (8.8%). Invalid specifications primarily resulted from SMT-LIB syntax, type, or symbol errors; failure to use constructs from the synthesized language; and empty outputs or malformed specification structures. The no-matching-pair cases comprised two groups: those containing at least one candidate pair whose equivalence remained unresolved by the solver mostly due to timeout, accounting for 17.6%, and those in which all candidate pairs were proven non-equivalent, accounting for 13.9%.

paragraphs.en: While manually examining changes in candidate distributions across representations, we encountered HumanEval/154, where a reference-consistent interpretation frequent in direct formalization lost its dominance under one of the two languages. Both language-conditioned distributions nevertheless remained concentrated. Inspecting their conflicting dominant specifications revealed an unresolved boundary case in the task description. We examine this case to show how cross-language disagreement can make different plausible interpretations apparent even when each language induces strong agreement. The results below use Qwen3.6-Flash in thinking mode.
paragraphs.zh: 在手动检查候选分布在各表示之间的变化时，我们遇到了 HumanEval/154：一个在直接形式化中常见的与参考实现一致的解释，在两种语言之一下失去了主导地位。 尽管如此，两种以语言为条件的分布仍保持集中。 检查它们相互冲突的主导规格后发现，任务描述中存在一个未解决的边界情况。 我们考察这一情况，以展示跨语言的分歧如何在每种语言都引发强一致性的情况下，仍能让不同但合理的解释显现出来。 以下结果使用思维模式下的 Qwen3.6-Flash。

paragraphs.en: HumanEval/154 asks whether a word or any of its rotations is a substring of another, without explicitly addressing an empty second word. Of 30 direct formalizations, 22 were valid and formed semantic classes of sizes [ 13 , 2 , 1 × 7 ] [13,2,1\times 7] . As shown in Figure 7 , the largest class, s 1 s_{1} , required True for a="abc" and b="" , matching the benchmark reference. The class of size two, s 2 s_{2} , required False . Plurality voting selected specifications representing s 1 s_{1} , while the plausible empty-word interpretation appeared in only a small minority of the direct candidates.
paragraphs.zh: HumanEval/154 询问某个单词或其任一旋转是否为另一个字符串的子串，但未明确处理第二个字符串为空的情况。 在 30 个直接形式化中，22 个有效并形成了大小为 [13, 2, 1×7] 的语义类。 如图 7 所示，最大的类 s₁ 要求 a="abc" 且 b="" 时结果为 True，与基准参考答案一致。 大小为二的类 s₂ 则要求结果为 False。 多数投票选中了代表 s₁ 的规格，而将空单词解释为成立的理解仅出现在直接候选中很小的少数派里。

paragraphs.en: Under the contrapuntal languages, the class-size distributions were [ 8 , 1 , 1 ] [8,1,1] in ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} and [ 10 ] [10] in ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} . The previously minor interpretation s 2 s_{2} now accounted for eight of ten candidates in ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} , whereas all ten candidates in ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} represented s 1 s_{1} . Each distribution was more concentrated around its dominant interpretation, but the two dominant classes were not equivalent. Stronger within-language agreement therefore did not settle the empty-word convention; comparing the languages brought another plausible interpretation into focus. This diagnosis is consistent with the SpecFix analysis ( Jia et al., 2025 ) , in which HumanEval/154 is among the 20 tasks identified as ambiguous by all models in their experiment. The cross-language contrast thus identifies a specific decision for the user.
paragraphs.zh: 在对位语言下，类别规模分布在 \mathcal{L}_{1} 中为 [8,1,1]，在 \mathcal{L}_{2} 中为 [10]。 此前处于次要地位的解释 s_{2} 如今占据了 \mathcal{L}_{1} 中十个候选中的八个，而 \mathcal{L}_{2} 中的全部十个候选都代表 s_{1}。 每个分布都更加集中于其主导解释附近，但这两个主导类别并不等价。 因此，语言内部更强的一致性并未解决空词约定问题；对比两种语言使另一种合理的解释成为焦点。 这一诊断与 SpecFix 分析（Jia 等，2025）一致，在该分析中 HumanEval/154 被列入其实验中所有模型均判定为含歧义的 20 个任务之中。 因此，这种跨语言对比为用户确定了一个具体决策。

paragraphs.en: This case study suggests a complementary role for representational diversity: beyond supporting specification validation, it may help expose ambiguity by making different plausible interpretations explicit. Future work could investigate when such disagreement is indicative of ambiguity and how distinguishing behaviors can be used to formulate targeted clarification questions for users.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究表明表征多样性可以起到补充作用：除了支持规格验证之外，它还可以通过显式呈现不同的合理解释来帮助暴露歧义。 未来的工作可以研究这种分歧何时能表明存在歧义，以及如何利用区分性行为为用户制定有针对性的澄清问题。

paragraphs.en: Our completeness and soundness judgments are relative to the tested behaviors, not exhaustive semantic correctness. In particular, killing a mutant establishes only that at least one observed incorrect output is rejected. We apply the same tests and criteria to all methods, providing a consistent basis for comparison within the intended input domain.

paragraphs.en: Test reduction may omit inputs that distinguish specifications. Our reduction criteria preserve complementary indicators of test effectiveness, including branch coverage and mutant detection, but these concern the programs used in reduction rather than exhaustive coverage of specification errors. Mutant selection also limits the faults represented; combining real wrong-answer submissions with LLM-generated variants on LiveCodeBench broadens these sources beyond generated mutations alone.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation covers two benchmarks of different complexity and three configurations spanning two model families and both thinking and non-thinking modes. Generalization to other settings and specification formalisms requires further evaluation. Reference outputs provide one interpretation of benchmark intent, but ambiguous descriptions may admit others. Our case study shows that cross-language disagreement can surface plausible alternatives, not determine which matches the user’s intent. Resolving such ambiguity requires confirmation from the requirement author or user, particularly for real-world requirements that may exhibit more substantial and diverse ambiguities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估覆盖了两个复杂度不同的基准、三种配置，涉及两个模型家族以及思考与非思考两种模式。 推广到其他设置和规约形式化方法还需要进一步评估。 参考输出提供了对基准意图的一种解释，但模糊的描述可能允许其他解释。 我们的案例研究表明，跨语言的不一致能够揭示出看似合理的其他方案，但无法确定哪一个符合用户的意图。 解决此类歧义需要需求作者或用户的确认，对于现实世界中的需求尤其如此，因为它们可能表现出更大规模、更多样化的歧义。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based autoformalization has been studied for mathematical statements and software specifications across theorem-prover languages, regular expressions, first-order and temporal logic ( Wu et al., 2022 ; Hahn et al., 2022 ) . In software engineering, recent work generates postconditions and richer contracts, often using program analysis or verification feedback ( Endres et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025a ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Richter and Wehrheim, 2025 ) . These works generate specifications in a given target formalism. However, generated specifications are themselves untrusted, and validating whether they capture the intended behavior without an external oracle remains challenging ( Lahiri, 2026 ) . We study oracle-free validation of autoformalized specifications, using two task- specific formal representations as validation views.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的自动形式化已被用于研究数学命题和软件规约，涵盖定理证明语言、正则表达式、一阶逻辑与时序逻辑（Wu et al., 2022；Hahn et al., 2022）。 在软件工程领域，近期的工作生成后置条件和更丰富的契约，通常借助程序分析或验证反馈（Endres et al., 2024；Ma et al., 2025a；Wen et al., 2024；Richter and Wehrheim, 2025）。 这些工作是在给定的目标形式化体系中生成规约。 然而，生成的规约本身并不可信，在没有外部预言机的情况下验证它们是否刻画了预期行为仍然具有挑战性（Lahiri, 2026）。 我们研究对自动形式化规约的无预言机验证，使用两种面向特定任务的形式化表示作为验证视角。

paragraphs.en: Li et al. ( Li et al., 2024 ) propose Symbolic Equivalence (SymEq), which scores candidates by equivalence-class size, and Semantic Consistency (SemCo), which scores back-translations by embedding similarity. We adapt SymEq into our plurality voting baseline by accepting specifications in the largest SMT-checked equivalence class. This provides a direct class-based acceptance rule, whereas using SemCo for acceptance would require an additional policy beyond its candidate-ranking scores. Amrollahi et al. ( Amrollahi et al., 2026 ) validate formalizations by checking equivalence after back-translation and re-formalization, and use verification failures to guide subsequent repair. We adopt their complete round-trip verification procedure as our baseline. Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2026 ) query users to disambiguate candidate assertions when needed, while Mendoza et al. ( Mendoza et al., 2026 ) use user judgments on distinguishing traces; these oracle-assisted workflows fall outside our oracle-free comparison. Semantic triangulation mitigates correlated errors through consistency across original and transformed programming problems ( Dai et al., 2026 ) , but targets code selection; adapting it would require specification-level transformations and consistency relations. We instead preserve task intent while varying its formal representation, validating agreement across two synthesized, structurally distinct languages.

paragraphs.en: Several systems improve specification synthesis through decomposition or fragment reuse. Clause2Inv reuses clauses from candidate invariants ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , while nl2spec and SynthTL expose structured sub-translations for correction or localized validation ( Cosler et al., 2023 ; Mendoza et al., 2024 ) . Req2LTL introduces a hierarchical intermediate representation ( Ma et al., 2025b ) , and KELPS studies aligned formalization across theorem-prover languages ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We likewise exploit intermediate structure, but synthesize two deliberately different decompositions of the same seeds, combining common seed coverage with structural difference to obtain validation evidence. We do not use these systems as baselines because they address generation, repair, or logic-specific translation rather than the validation setting studied here.
paragraphs.zh: 若干系统通过分解或片段复用来改进规约合成。 Clause2Inv 复用候选不变式中的子句（Cao et al., 2025），而 nl2spec 和 SynthTL 提供结构化的子翻译以便进行修正或局部验证（Cosler et al., 2023; Mendoza et al., 2024）。 Req2LTL 引入了一种分层中间表示（Ma et al., 2025b），KELPS 则研究了跨定理证明器语言的统一形式化（Zhang et al., 2025）。 我们同样利用中间结构，但对同一批种子合成两种刻意不同的分解，将共同种子覆盖与结构差异相结合以获得验证证据。 我们没有将这些系统作为基线，因为它们解决的是生成、修复或特定逻辑的翻译，而非本文所研究的验证场景。

paragraphs.en: When a reference formalization is available, candidates can be evaluated against it; for example, BEq+ establishes bidirectional implication using deterministic Lean proofs ( Poiroux et al., 2025 ) . Without references, prior work relies on behavioral evidence: Endres et al. ( Endres et al., 2024 ) evaluate postconditions using trusted tests and buggy mutants, while Lahiri ( Lahiri, 2024 ) uses symbolic testing with mutated outputs. FormalBench combines deductive verification with mutation analysis ( Le-Cong et al., 2025 ) , while Coins evaluates Rocq specifications on positive and mutation-derived negative cases through concrete proof obligations ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Without reference formal specifications, we follow this test-based evaluation approach, using positive tests, negative tests, and mutant killing as behavioral approximations of specification quality.
paragraphs.zh: 当存在参考形式化时，可以据此对候选结果进行评估；例如，BEq+ 使用确定性的 Lean 证明建立双向蕴含（Poiroux et al., 2025）。 在没有参考的情况下，先前的工作依赖行为证据：Endres et al. （Endres et al., 2024）使用可信测试和带缺陷的变异体评估后置条件，而 Lahiri（Lahiri, 2024）使用带变异输出的符号测试。 FormalBench 将演绎验证与变异分析相结合（Le-Cong et al., 2025），而 Coins 通过具体的证明义务在正例和由变异得到的负例上评估 Rocq 规约（Yang et al., 2026）。 在没有参考形式化规约的情况下，我们遵循这种基于测试的评估方法，将正测试、负测试和变异体杀死作为规约质量的行为近似。

paragraphs.en: Constraint solving has long been used to synthesize programs and repairs. Oracle-guided component-based synthesis encodes the composition of program components as SMT constraints ( Jha et al., 2010 ) , while DirectFix builds on component-based synthesis and MaxSAT to search for simple program repairs ( Mechtaev et al., 2015 ) . Our setting changes the object being synthesized: we use SMT to construct formal languages rather than programs or patches. The encoding searches over cuts of seed formulas and constrains the resulting fragment-tree shapes to obtain an effectively contrapuntal language pair.
paragraphs.zh: 约束求解长期以来被用于合成程序与修复补丁。 基于预言机引导的基于组件的合成将程序组件的组合编码为 SMT 约束（ Jha et al., 2010 ），而 DirectFix 则建立在基于组件的合成与 MaxSAT 之上来搜索简单的程序修复（ Mechtaev et al., 2015 ）。 我们的设定改变了被合成的对象：我们使用 SMT 来构造形式语言，而不是程序或补丁。 该编码在种子公式的切分上进行搜索，并对所得片段树的形状加以约束，从而得到一个有效的对位式语言对。

paragraphs.en: We presented an oracle-free approach to validating autoformalized specifications through contrapuntal languages , pairs of task-specific formal languages, each designed to express the intended specification, yet admitting no structure-preserving translation between them. By guiding LLM to formalize the same intent along different representational paths, our approach uses solver-checked agreement as evidence of correctness. Experiments on HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench show that our approach improves the proportion of accepted specifications that are complete and sound over the strongest baseline on average, supporting deliberately structured representational diversity as a means of making agreement more informative for specification validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无神谕的方法，通过对位语言（contrapuntal languages）来验证自动形式化的规约。对位语言是成对的任务专用形式语言，每种语言都被设计用于表达目标规约，但二者之间不存在保持结构的翻译。 通过引导大语言模型沿着不同的表示路径对同一意图进行形式化，我们的方法将以求解器验证的一致性作为正确性的证据。 在 HumanEval+ 和 LiveCodeBench 上的实验表明，与最强的基线相比，我们的方法平均提升了被接受规约中完整且可靠规约的比例，从而支持将刻意构建的表示多样性作为让一致性对规约验证更具信息量的一种手段。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the mean entropy increases from 1.436 bits at N = 5 N=5 to 2.839 bits at N = 30 N=30 , with progressively smaller gains as the sampling budget grows. Increasing N N further from 30 to 50 raises the mean entropy to 3.168 bits—an additional 0.329 bits, or 11.6%, despite a 66.7% increase in sampling budget. Although the entropy continues to increase, these diminishing returns suggest that larger sample sizes provide comparatively modest gains in measured semantic diversity. We therefore select N = 30 N=30 as a practical trade-off between representing specification diversity and limiting sampling and equivalence-analysis costs.
paragraphs.zh: 如图9所示，平均熵从 N=5 时的1.436比特增加到 N=30 时的2.839比特，且随着采样预算的增长，增益逐渐变小。 将 N 从30进一步增加到50，平均熵提高到3.168比特——即额外增加0.329比特，或11.6%，而采样预算却增加了66.7%。 尽管熵持续增加，但这些收益递减的现象表明，更大的样本量在测得的语义多样性方面带来的提升相对有限。 因此，我们选择 N=30 作为在表示规格多样性与限制采样及等价性分析成本之间的实际折中。
